panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Active bits of the shutdown / loaddump / warning tables with their 500-MODBUS names. Empty when no alarm is active.

panels.title: Genset power
panels.description: Total active power of the genset (controller register 10294, sum of L1-L3).

panels.title: Last crank voltage
panels.description: Minimum battery voltage measured by the controller during the last cranking (500-MODBUS 10385, read every 5 min).

title: Generator (datakom-exporter)
description: Datakom genset controller via datakom-exporter (genset_* metrics)
